description: This PHP class extends tlFilterControl to manage filters and settings at the GUI level for the TestLink test management platform, specifically handling test case filters by requirements. It includes methods for initializing filters, managing session data, generating tree structures for test case navigation, and handling user input for filtering options. The file is integral to the functionality of filtering and displaying test cases within the TestLink interface based on various criteria such as status, type, coverage, and custom fields.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl
classes.description: Extends tlFilterControl to provide GUI-level filtering logic for test cases by requirements in TestLink. Manages various filter options like status, type, coverage, assigned user, and custom fields, and handles session-based state preservation for multi-tab scenarios. Contains numerous initialization and management methods for controlling the filtering workflow within the interface.
